verdict.note: B: the real Git suite exercises wrapper selection and bounded child invocation without PATH probing churn.

A: a real 5000-path Git tree emitted more than 1 MiB; sync git() failed in 181ms with spawnSync ENOBUFS, while the adapter falsely labeled the SIGKILL as a 120000ms timeout. The same default-buffer boundary aborted the pending adopter-a merge hook.
